vswitch_id.description: The ID of the VSwitch used by the instance.

i18n.en-US: The ID of the VSwitch used by the instance.

backup_set_id.description: The ID of the backup set created by the manual backup. Null when enable_backup is false.

i18n.zh-Hans: 手动备份创建的备份集ID。enable_backup 为 false 时为 null。
i18n.en-US: The ID of the backup set created by the manual backup. Null when enable_backup is false.

backup_status.description: The status of the manual backup. Valid values: 0 (creating), 1 (success), 2 (failed). Null when enable_backup is false.

i18n.zh-Hans: 手动备份的状态。有效值：0（创建中）、1（成功）、2（失败）。enable_backup 为 false 时为 null。
i18n.en-US: The status of the manual backup. Valid values: 0 (creating), 1 (success), 2 (failed). Null when enable_backup is false.
